globalDesignRules: Persian RTL; client dates/times localized for Asia/Tehran while API date-time values remain UTC.
GUID and rowversion are hidden integration fields, not labels shown to users.
401 login;403 denied;404 missing/hidden;409/412 conflict;429 rate limit. Preserve user draft on errors.
Do not blind-retry mutations or fabricate successful receipts; use declared idempotency and version semantics.

designRules: Phone entry and OTP are separate pages. Use server resend/expiry timestamps. Do not hardcode six digits. Normalize Persian/Arabic digits. No public mock bypass.

Separate view/edit/photo pages. firstName,lastName,displayName(nullable),username,dateOfBirth(optional Gregorian date). No bio/password/phone edit/social stats fields. Ready personal JPEG/PNG own upload; protected download. DOB is not age proof.

Only permitted workspaces/roles shown. Student/Teacher/Parent/Manager are organization roles. Personal is separate. Child context is authorized server-side. Consent to guardian invitation is explicit.
Four distinct role homes. Data cards may use Instagram visual language, but represent actual lessons, tasks, classes, schedule and authorized channel messages. No aggregate social-post API.
Create class: academicPeriodId,courseId,title,capacity,activateImmediately. Manager creates class; resource authorization controls roster. No supported class/course/period edit route.

Create and edit pages distinct. title,plain body,displayOrder,fileAssetIds; edit expectedVersion. Draft hidden from student; published immutable; Parent has no independent lesson grant. Publish needs text or file.
title,description,dueAtUtc,allowLateSubmission,maxAttempts,maxScore. Separate create/edit/review-publish. Grade scale is 0..configured maxScore, not universally 20. Respect frozen published version.
Draft, attachment processing, final submission and receipt are distinct. Retain draft on network error; deadline/attempt allowance from server; no fabricated submit success.
Evaluation edit, publish and correction separate tasks. Student/Parent see only released grade and allowed feedback; private evaluator note excluded. Correction requires reason/version.
Separate exam create/edit/question create/question edit/preview/publish. Date window,duration,maxAttempts,maxScore,randomization. Published question snapshot frozen; new version explicit.

Server deadline and autosave acknowledgments. Explicit other-device conflict/transfer page. Final receipt only after server finalization; no auto-finalize/grace assumption. Grade private until released.
Session create/edit separate; recurring schedule create/edit separate. Local time + timeZoneId and date range. Missing attendance is unrecorded, not absent. Correction requires reason.

Person record distinct from account/membership/enrollment. Only allowed names editable for unlinked/nonshared identity. Guardian invite exactly one username or phone; existing account; future expiry <=30d; reason; explicit consent. No child private Direct browsing.

Inbox filters All/Direct/Group/Channel/Unread/Archived/Saved. Channel stream is permitted message history, not social feed endpoint. Search supports current authorization and attachment/link/topic filters.

Separate new Direct recipient flow; group/channel create; edit info; edit settings; member permissions. Group info supports title/description, not confirmed photo upload. Respect canStartDirect/age/privacy.

Edit message separate page per design request. Text/image/video/voice/file/contact kinds exist; voice/video calls do not. Sending/review/blocked/unavailable/sent distinct. Scheduled is not Sent. Respect edit/delete window and versions.

Separate create topic/edit topic/create poll/create checklist/edit checklist. Quiz key not exposed before permitted time. Personal and Collaborative checklist state distinct. Poll vote may be immutable.
Contact add/edit separate; savedName/isFavorite. Privacy for Direct/phone visibility/phone discovery/invites/online/lastSeen. Unknown age protected like minor. No exposure of private Hidden reasons.
Invite expires/max uses/approval. Pending join separate from joined. Restriction uses current authorization. Report receipt not automatic removal. Moderation evidence restricted to case.
Role-filtered report types. CSV job Queued/Processing/Completed/Failed; only ready completed authorized download. Source permissions rechecked during job and download.

In-app list supported. Push preference constrained by isMandatory/canDisablePush; quiet hours and timezone. Push runtime remains pending in document; registered/accepted is not delivered. General SMS unavailable.

Contract supports order lifecycle. Real payment gateway unavailable per document; design pending/unavailable. Success only after server verification. No public plans listing route; do not expose Platform plans as unrestricted purchase feed.

12 endpoints total; representative 7 mapped here. Default disabled; full runtime verification deferred in document. Context403/rate429/invalid502/unavailable503/timeout504; no provider raw error or blind auto retry.

Separate role/capabilities, school Manager is not Platform admin. Additional IAM/provisioning/education/finance/operations workflows exist. No MFA/TOTP/recovery/step-up screens. No unrestricted Direct/Contacts browsing/impersonation/manual payment-success.
